address.note_zip: Booksy's own listing shows postal code 33069, but Salon Lofts' own stylist profile (the authoritative source for this address, since Salon Lofts is the property/tenant record) lists 33062, which also matches the Ocean Blvd / oceanfront location implied by the geo coordinates below. Used 33062.

hours_note: Only hours published on Booksy's booking calendar (openHours in Booksy's Nuxt payload, dayOfWeek 2-6 = Tue-Sat). Closed Sunday and Monday. No additional walk-in hours found published anywhere.

instagram_note: Two different real, verified Instagram handles were found: (1) 'beauty_by.christina', confirmed by matching account-name overlays visible on multiple of her own posts (both Instagram-style and TikTok-tagged) that she uploaded herself into Booksy's 'inspiration' photo gallery for this business (files bk-insp-1/2/4/6 in assets/raw before curation removed the ones with visible overlay text) -- this is the business-branded account, matching the business name exactly, and is the one used in the site and outreach. (2) '@c_wittexo' (plus Facebook 'cwh1013'), listed as her personal sameAs on her official Salon Lofts stylist profile (salonlofts.com/christina_hughes, JSON-LD employee.sameAs). Could not verify either handle live via the Instagram web_profile_info API (rate-limited/blocked from this environment), so confidence rests on the first-party self-uploaded content match rather than a live profile fetch.
website_check_note: beautybychristina.com returns 404 (verified in prior discovery). No website field on Booksy (website: null in Booksy's business payload) or Salon Lofts profile. Only presence is Booksy, Salon Lofts stylist directory, and Instagram/TikTok.
email_note: Reconfirmed live on 2026-08-12 by fetching salonlofts.com/christina_hughes directly (curl with browser UA); email appears both in visible page text and in the page's embedded JSON-LD (employee.email). Not present anywhere in Booksy's own data.
services_source: Extracted directly from Booksy's server-rendered Nuxt payload (window.__NUXT_DATA__ devalue-serialized state) for business id 823357, resolving each service's variants[0].price and variants[0].duration. Cross-checked against the JSON-LD makesOffer prices on the same page (identical prices for all 19 services).

reviews.author: Kim
reviews.body: Christina took her time to help me get my very fussy hair to a natural color that suits me. She is a true artist and very professional.

reviews.body: Excellent haircut. Best haircut I have ever had.

reviews.body: Love her and her spot is so cute great experience

Rebecca and Phyllis were provided as already-verified in the discovery brief and used as given (not re-fetchable from the 3-review page currently exposed in Booksy's payload, which may only show a recent subset).
brand_vibe: christina-plum: cream/blush base (#faf3ef) with deep wine/burgundy accent (#7a2f45) and dusty rose mid-tone (#a9647a), derived directly from the business's own logo (wordmark 'BEAUTY BY CHRISTINA' in deep plum serif type with a fine-line botanical branch illustration, cream background) found on both Booksy and Salon Lofts.
images_source: 13 real photos downloaded: 8 from Christina's own portfolio gallery on her Salon Lofts stylist profile (salonlofts.com/christina_hughes, s3.amazonaws.com/images.salonlofts.com/system/images/), and 5 from Booksy's 'inspiration' photo set for business 823357 (cloudfront-hosted). All resized to max 1000px width. Excluded: photos with visible face masks (dated/COVID-era), photos with heavy Instagram/TikTok caption overlays or store signage text across the subject, and two near-duplicate logo-only files. One casual selfie (sl-profile.jpg) is used only as a small circular stylist avatar in the About section, never as a gallery tile, per pipeline rules.
